answer: Pay each agent only its Shapley value: the marginal lift its work adds to a coalition output, averaged over every join order. A clone contributes nothing once its twin is already seated, so the second, third, and thousandth copy each score near zero. An operator spinning up a swarm tends a sterile garden where every extra sprout is the same yarrow, adding no fresh bloom, while a genuinely distinct agent shines like a lone beacon the coalition actually needed. Influence tracks unique marginal contribution, not headcount, so cloning yourself buys no reward at all.
